Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the practice settings for certified chemical dependency professionals and trainees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to practice settings for certified chemicaldependency professionals and trainees; and amending RCW 18.205.040.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.205.040 and 2008 c 135 s 17 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to authorize the useof the title)) (1) A person credentialed as a "certified chemicaldependency professional" or a "certified chemical dependencyprofessional trainee" ((when treating)) may treat patients only in((settings other than)) programs approved under chapter 70.96A RCW. (2) A person credentialed as a "certified chemical dependencyprofessional" or a "certified chemical dependency professional trainee"who also holds a license as an advanced registered nurse practitionerunder chapter 18.79 RCW, marriage and family therapist, mental healthcounselor, advanced social worker, or independent clinical socialworker under chapter 18.225 RCW, psychologist under chapter 18.83 RCW,osteopathic physician under chapter 18.57 RCW, osteopathic physicianassistant under chapter 18.57A RCW, physician under chapter 18.71 RCW, p. 1 SB 6140or a physician assistant under 18.71A RCW may treat patients insettings other than programs approved under chapter 70.96A RCW.
